mapper.sql: SELECT emp21_un_leave_id AS un_leave_id , emp21_person_id AS person_id , emp21_un_leave_cd AS un_leave_code , f_cdnm('unLeaveCode', emp21_un_leave_cd, emp21_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS un_leave_name , emp21_start_date AS start_date , emp21_remain_days AS remain_days , emp21_appr_id AS appr_id , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01.apr01_status_cd, emp21_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS appr_status_name , emp21_expect_appr_id AS expect_appr_id , apr02.apr01_status_cd AS expect_appr_status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr02.apr01_status_cd, emp21_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS expect_appr_status_name FROM emp21_un_leave INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp21_person_id INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp21_person_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp21_company_id INNER JOIN apr01_appr apr01 ON apr01.apr01_appr_id = emp21_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr02 ON apr02.apr01_appr_id = emp21_expect_appr_id
